description: Getting workers ready for retirement is the focus of Voya Financial, which provides workplace benefits and savings solutions and technologies in the United States and internationally. The company operates through three segments: wealth solutions, health solutions, and investment management. Voya serves some 39,000 U.S. employers and over 7 million individual retirement plan participants and has approximately 450 financial professionals serving retail and workplace clients. The company was formerly known as ING U.S. and changed its name to Voya Financial in April 2014. Voya Financial was founded in 1975.

title: Voya Financial

rankings.title: Best Large Workplaces in Financial Services and Insurance
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say: 

"The benefits are some of the best I have ever had, particularly the backup care and the tuition repayment assistance. From a work standpoint, I also love that my leader appreciates what I have to say and my ideas. I feel connected to and comfortable talking to my leader's leaders, because they have created an environment of openness and caring. There is buzz from my teammates all the way to my boss's boss's boss about the exciting things people are working on, and a connectivity between these levels that I have not experienced with other employers. I do not feel like a cog, I feel like what I do matters and I am excited to be part of my team."

rankings.title: Best Large Workplaces in New York
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say:

"I love the culture—volunteerism is really important here and I love that. I love the mindset my team has of working hard and performing quality work; but also have fun and be kind to each other, lead with compassion and understanding. Benefits are great, pay is competitive, and work life balance is real. I feel trusted and respected by my peers and leaders to use my judgment and make the right decisions for my customers. I truly enjoy working here."

rankings.title: Best Large Workplaces in Financial Services and Insurance
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say:

"I love the financial support from this company. This is my first employer where I feel like the company actually cares about the wellbeing of the employees with benefits like the student loan assistance, generous 401k match and pension plan. I also enjoy my department a lot and how many opportunities we get to be involved with larger projects, as well as opportunities to lead meetings to develop our leadership & collaboration skills. The volunteer time is also a huge plus for me, it is nice to see the company want to give back."

rankings.title: Best Large Workplaces in New York
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say:

"I love Voya! This is the very best company I have ever worked for, and my loyalty will always be with them. My manager is amazing and supports my dreams here at Voya. Very encouraging and positive. I run to my computer every morning and it's a blessing in itself to work here! I'm proud to say I'm a Voya employee as they put the customer and employees first. We focus on teamwork and always keep the vision in mind. The benefits are phenomenal and I'm confident they give us all the tools we need to be successful. We also have additional training websites for those who want to grow in the organization at no cost! This is unheard of!"

rankings.title: Best Large Workplaces for Parents
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say:

"The support that this company gives women is incredible. Full access to programs like Maven truly shows how much the company cares for women and recognizes the need to provide additional support. Regardless on how difficult things might get at work, the support I have via Maven and other benefits help me to show up to work at my best. I also am a very big fan of the paid volunteer time - it is enough hours to feel that I truly can give back to my community and have a presence. It also allows me to set a great example to my children on social responsibility."
